items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Berg's with Billy Berg in California. Billy Berg had three places.

ctx.x: Did he join Basie after he left Cab or before? After he left Cab I guess it was.
After he left Cab, Jacquet had things playing in The Streets of Paris and Berg's with Billy Berg in California. Billy Berg had three places.
Then he joined Basie. That's when he made the record, 'The King.'
